description: This file defines an interface 'ShippingQuoteModule' for shipping quote-related operations within a sales management system, including configuration validation and obtaining shipping quotes.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the shipping module configuration for a given integration configuration and merchant store.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom integration configuration specific to the merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Fetches a list of shipping options based on package details, order total, delivery info, store, configuration, module, shipping configuration, and locale.
